expectation: Canonical psc-wasm-literal-expectation/1 with exact unique name, source scalar type (uint32/int32/bool) and canonical decimal value for every export. Source ranges are checked before normalizing to the i32 bit pattern.
sourceProjection: The portable psWasmEncodeLiteralExpectation API freshly validates actual SpecializedIR, rejects unsupported source features and derives canonical expected names/types/values from its declarations. The focused fixture connects this actual projection and the actual target lowerer/encoder to the independent binary decoder. Production artifact/authority binding still remains required.
decoder: Independent host implementation, without using the compiler encoder. Bounds bytes, functions, types, names and expectations; checks section order, lengths, LEB ranges, UTF-8, closed parameterless i32 function types, literal-only code, type/code correspondence and a full one-to-one export/function relation. Plain function types and explicit recursive groups of closed function types are supported. Legal padded LEB encodings are accepted. Custom sections have validated UTF-8 names and ignored bounded payloads.
certificate: Built-in wasm-literal checker replays pinned binary/expectation snapshots. psc-wasm-literal-binary-subject/1 binds both ArtifactIds. Claim class is only wasm-closed-i32-literal-export-behavior. CLI policy kind wasm-literal supplies binaryId, expectationId, subjectId and optional resourceLimits; archive code/URLs never select the implementation.
focusedEvidence: Ten portable source/target shape cases; independent handwritten bytes and actual PSC lowering/encoding fixtures executed by Node WebAssembly for uint32 max, int32 min and Bool true; malformed/drift/overflow/padded-encoding/budget cases; actual certificate replay and offline CLI replay. No broad backend campaign or checked theorem is claimed.
authority: Validation data for binary-to-expectation only. Binding an actual checked source or SpecializedIR artifact to that expectation remains separately required. No kernel capability, arbitrary-source preservation claim or release acceptance follows.
remaining: independent broad assurance and Lean preservation proofs
